subject: Re: Novatek RFP — request for additional evaluation credits
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novatek.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: trialops@novatek.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Novatek RFP — request for additional evaluation credits

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We're lining up a competitive bake-off next month (Nov 1–10 internal pilot window) against AtlasAI and a couple of other vendors. The RFP requires us to run two end-to-end benchmarks: throughput-heavy generation and a reranking/semantic search comparison.

Given the scope, our engineering team will need a larger sandbox allocation than the default trial. Can Redwood provide a top-up for the Novatek evaluation? Ballpark ask: 150k generation tokens + 25k embedding units, 30-day extension of the sandbox, and prioritized support during the bake-off.

We can share the evaluation script and success criteria (attached). We have an internal deadline to lock vendors by 7/25, so a fast yes/no would be appreciated.

Attachment: Novatek_RFP_Scope.pdf (1.2MB)

Best,
Alicia Park
Sr. Product Ops — Novatek Systems

---
Novatek Systems | alicia.park@novatek.com | +1 415-555-0128
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novatek.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novatek RFP — request for additional evaluation credits

Alicia — appreciate the note and the RFP scope.

Short answer: we can support a conditional top-up for competitive bake-offs like this. Before I pull the trigger, I want to align internal guardrails so we don't set a precedent that will create downstream risk.

Proposed package (tentative):
- 150,000 generation tokens + 25,000 embedding units for the Novatek sandbox
- 30-day sandbox window tied to the bake-off dates you shared
- Priority engineering queue during the evaluation (two scheduled office-hours)
- Requirement: Novatek shares the evaluation harness and final comparison artifact with Redwood within 14 days of the pilot close (for model fairness auditing)

Open questions for our side:
- Is any of the evaluation hitting customer data or PII? (we need to ensure sandbox isolation)
- Can we get a short MOU or signature confirming it's strictly evaluation sandbox usage?

Looping in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Ben (Finance) for formal approval and to validate the amounts / terms. Alicia — if you're comfortable, I'll ask Sales Ops to prepare the terms doc and a DocuSign route.

— David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novatek.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novatek RFP — request for additional evaluation credits

Thanks David — I reviewed the RFP scope. I'm willing to approve a conditional allocation, with the following constraints (we should be explicit to avoid scope creep):

Approved conditional package:
- 125,000 generation tokens + 25,000 embedding units (sandbox only)
- 30 calendar days from activation
- Monitoring hooks enabled (we'll require access to the evaluation metrics dashboard)
- Usage cap hard limit at the token amounts specified; overage will require pre-approval and will be billable
- Allowed models: Redwood-curated open models only (no customer-supplied models)
- Must sign the Bake-off MOU (attached) and accept sandbox terms before allocation

Action items for David / Sales:
1) Get MOU signed by 7/26 (DocuSign link to follow)
2) Log the top-up in HubSpot (deal id DEAL-7839) with the amount and terms
3) Ask engineering to enable priority support (2 office-hours + Slack escalation channel) during Nov 1–10 window

Attachment: bakeoff-credit-terms-v1.docx

Ben — FYI, please confirm finance and I can finalize.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novatek.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novatek RFP — request for additional evaluation credits

Marissa — I ran the numbers with Finance. We can approve the conditional allocation but will tighten the token count to limit exposure. Final approval: 125,000 generation tokens + 20,000 embedding units.

Notes:
- Sandbox-only and MOU signed are hard requirements.
- We'll provision the top-up as a single-use credit with a usage cap.
- I'll prepare the approval packet and an Excel schedule for tracking (attached).

David / Marissa — once you confirm, I'll kick off the DocuSign envelope. Alicia, once executed, we'll provision the credits and send the activation details and priority support contacts.

Attachment: approved-credit-schedule.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novatek.com>

David / Marissa / Ben — thank you, and that package works for us. We accept the adjusted allocation (125k generation / 20k embeddings) and will sign the MOU today so you can provision.

A few quick notes from our side:
- We'll keep the test corpus anonymized; no production customer PII will be used.
- We'll share the evaluation harness + final results in the 14-day post-eval window as requested.

Please send the DocuSign link when ready. Looking forward to working together on this bake-off.

Cheers,
Alicia
